description: This file defines the BiometricAuthManager class responsible for handling biometric authentication using Local Authentication framework. It provides an asynchronous method to authenticate the user with biometrics, with fallback to device passcode.

classes.name: BiometricAuthManager
classes.description: A singleton class managing biometric authentication using LocalAuthentication framework.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs biometric authentication asynchronously, with fallback to passcode; throws errors if authentication is unavailable or fails.
